Community Contact Center (CCC) Operator Job at International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)




        
    

        
        Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence. In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on.

We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Community Contact Center (CCC) Operator

Job Location: Abuja  (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Purpose


	Under the supervision of the Community Contact Centre Supervisor, The Community Contact Centre (CCC) operator aims to increase ICRC’s Accountability to the persons we serve.
	The CCC receive questions, complaints and comments from callers from around Nigeria in connection with their humanitarian needs and ICRC activities.
	The Contact Centre will also share information on ICRC programs and criteria for eligibility with callers, at times pro-actively and will occasionally also carry out small surveys on behalf of the ICRC.
	It is also used to proactively call persons affected by the conflict and violence to gauge their views and perception, with a view to improving our assistance and service to them.


Accountabilities & Functional Responsibilities


	Respond to calls to understand the concerns of the caller and decide on whether the concerns can be addressed immediately or require referral to other specialists or departments.
	Make calls to persons affected by conflict and violence in Nigeria to assess their level of satisfaction with, and perceptions of, ICRC activities and services.
	Accurately record and maintain details of each call in the appropriate database / software.
	Follow up promptly on complaints and provide timely feedback to Affected Population
	Follow up on cases referred to other departments to ensure timely follow up and action.
	Contribute to the compilation of statistics and regular Community Contact Centre reports identifying trends, flagging issues and proposing improvements.
	Maintain a good understanding of the ICRC’s activities around Nigeria by reviewing briefing materials, following relevant guidance and SOPs, participating in regular briefing sessions, and proactively seeking information from relevantdepartments.
	Carry out any other duties related to Accountability to Affected persons shall the need arise.


Certifications / Education Required


	A University Degree in a relevant field.
	Minimum 2 years of professional experience in a similar position
	Proficiency in English, Kanuri and Hausa.
	Knowledge of Shuwa Arab, Pidgin, Fulfulde an asset.
	Good understanding of humanitarian issues and current events in Nigeria
	Experience using online dashboards for data analysis and prior experience working with technology for humanitarian organizations is desirable
	Good understanding of the importance of knowledge management and confidentiality
	Strong organizational and planning skills.


Desired profile and skills:


	Strongly motivated by humanitarian work
	Able to work under pressure.


Our values:


	At the ICRC, we value impact, collaboration, respect, and compassion. We seek candidates who demonstrate behaviors based on these shared values. For more information on the ICRC values, please visit this page.


Reports to (role):


	Community Contact Centre (CCC) Supervisor.


People management responsibilities:


	No.


Relationships:


	Internally, interacts with colleagues in the delegation or sub-structure.
	Externally, interacts with a network of local contacts, such as authorities, opposition leaders, non-State armed groups, the civilian population, international and organizations, non-governmental organizations and International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement partners.


What we offer


	Rewarding work in a humanitarian and multicultural environment.
	Competitive employment package with medical insurance and ICRC pension plan.
	In-house training opportunities for personal development.
	A full-time, fixed-term contract (4months - Maternity Cover)
	The opportunity to join an ICRC talent pool, be considered for future assignments elsewhere and experience different contexts, fields, and challenges.

  "title": "Total Rewards Officer",
  "description": "Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited has a Vision to be the market leader in the Day Old Chicks market; through exceptional quality products and services that will guarantee profitable poultry farming.

The Company produces high-quality Day-Old Chicks and Point of Cage Pullets. Over the years, we have remained focused on our main objective to produce high quality chicks, in a highly hygienic environment leveraging innovative solutions grounded in Research and Development.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Total Rewards Officer

Job Location: Magodo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited is seeking a highly analytical, strategic and detail-oriented Total Rewards Officer to join our Human Resources team.
	The successful candidate will support the development and administration of the Company&#39;s total rewards framework, ensuring that compensation, benefits, recognition and employee reward programmes are competitive, equitable, cost-effective and aligned with business objectives.
	This role will combine compensation and benefits administration with reward analytics, salary benchmarking, job evaluation, employee recognition and reward programme management.


The Role


	The Total Rewards Officer will support the design, implementation and administration of reward programmes that attract, motivate and retain high-performing employees.
	The role will work closely with HR, Finance, Payroll and Management to ensure that the Company&#39;s reward structures are accurate, competitive, internally equitable and compliant with applicable laws and Company policies.
	The successful candidate will be expected to use data and market intelligence to provide insights that support Management&#39;s compensation and reward decisions.


Key Responsibilities
Total Rewards Strategy &amp; Administration:


	Support the implementation of the Company&#39;s Total Rewards strategy in alignment with business objectives.
	Assist in developing and maintaining compensation and reward frameworks across the organisation.
	Ensure reward programmes are consistently and fairly administered across employee groups.
	Review existing reward practices and recommend improvements based on business needs, employee expectations and market trends.
	Support the development of reward policies, guidelines and procedures.
	Maintain accurate documentation of reward structures, programmes and employee eligibility.


Compensation Management:


	Administer salary structures, salary bands, allowances and other fixed and variable compensation components.
	Process approved salary adjustments arising from promotions, confirmations, transfers, annual reviews and other employee movements.
	Review compensation changes for accuracy, appropriate approvals and alignment with established salary structures.
	Support annual salary review and merit increase exercises.
	Analyse compensation data to identify anomalies, inconsistencies and potential internal equity concerns.
	Support the development and review of incentive and variable-pay programmes.


Salary Benchmarking &amp; Market Intelligence:


	Conduct regular salary benchmarking against relevant industries, sectors and labour markets.
	Participate in external salary surveys and compensation benchmarking exercises.
	Analyse market data and provide recommendations on salary positioning.
	Monitor compensation trends and emerging reward practices.
	Prepare reports showing the Company&#39;s pay position relative to relevant market benchmarks.
	Support Management in making evidence-based compensation decisions.


Job Evaluation, Grading &amp; Salary Structures:


	Support job evaluation and classification exercises.
	Assist in maintaining the Company&#39;s job grading framework.
	Review jobs to ensure appropriate alignment between job responsibilities, grades and compensation.
	Support the development and maintenance of salary ranges and pay bands.
	Identify and report potential internal pay equity issues.
	Ensure approved job and salary structures are accurately reflected in HR records.


Employee Benefits:


	Coordinate the administration of employee benefits in line with approved Company policies.
	Manage employee eligibility, enrolment, changes and exits relating to benefit programmes.
	Liaise with HMO providers, insurers, pension administrators and other benefit service providers.
	Monitor service provider performance and resolve benefit-related issues.
	Maintain accurate employee benefit records.
	Support periodic reviews of benefits to assess competitiveness, utilisation and cost-effectiveness.
	Provide employees with clear information on their benefit entitlements.


Payroll &amp; Reward Controls:


	Provide accurate compensation and benefits inputs to Payroll and Finance.
	Validate salary changes, allowances, deductions, incentives, bonuses and other reward-related payroll inputs.
	Conduct reconciliation and validation checks to identify payroll discrepancies.
	Investigate and resolve compensation-related payroll queries.
	Ensure all reward-related changes have appropriate approvals and supporting documentation.
	Maintain strong controls to prevent unauthorised payments, errors and overpayments.


Statutory &amp; Regulatory Compliance:


	Support compliance with applicable Nigerian laws and regulations affecting employee compensation and benefits.
	Monitor changes in PAYE, pension and other statutory requirements that may impact employee rewards.
	Ensure reward processes are consistent with applicable employment and statutory requirements.
	Liaise with relevant statutory bodies and service providers where required.
	Support internal and external audits relating to compensation and benefits.


Performance &amp; Incentive Rewards:


	Support the design and administration of performance-linked reward programmes.
	Assist with the administration of bonuses, incentives and other variable-pay schemes.
	Ensure incentive programmes are applied consistently and accurately.
	Analyse incentive programme effectiveness and provide recommendations for improvement.
	Work with HR and Management to ensure reward outcomes are appropriately aligned with performance and business results.


Recognition &amp; Employee Reward Programmes:


	Support the development and administration of employee recognition programmes.
	Coordinate long-service awards, performance recognition, spot awards and other approved recognition initiatives.
	Monitor participation and effectiveness of recognition programmes.
	Recommend innovative and cost-effective ways to recognise and reward employees.
	Ensure recognition initiatives support the Company&#39;s culture and desired behaviours.


Reward Analytics &amp; Reporting:


	Develop regular Total Rewards reports and dashboards for HR and Management.
	Analyse salary structures, compensation costs, benefits utilisation and reward trends.
	Prepare compensation and benefits reports for Management decision-making.
	Track reward-related KPIs and identify emerging trends.
	Analyse employee compensation by grade, function, location and other relevant categories.
	Provide data-driven insights to support workforce planning and reward decisions.


Reward Budgeting &amp; Cost Management:


	Support the preparation of annual compensation and benefits budgets.
	Monitor reward expenditure against approved budgets.
	Analyse the financial impact of proposed salary reviews, allowances, benefits and incentive schemes.
	Identify opportunities to optimise reward costs without compromising employee value.
	Support Management with cost-impact analysis for proposed reward initiatives.


Employee Communication &amp; Advisory:


	Respond to employee enquiries relating to compensation, benefits and reward programmes.
	Explain reward policies, salary structures and benefit provisions clearly and professionally.
	Prepare employee communication materials relating to reward initiatives.
	Support the development of employee total reward statements where applicable.
	Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive employee compensation information.


Process Improvement:


	Review Total Rewards processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, accuracy and employee experience.
	Develop and maintain appropriate process documentation and controls.
	Recommend improvements to HR systems and reward administration processes.
	Support automation and digitisation of compensation and benefits processes where appropriate.
	Ensure reward processes are consistently applied across the organisation.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Relations or a related discipline.
	Professional certification or membership of CIPM, SHRM, WorldatWork, ICAN, ACCA or another relevant professional body will be an advantage.
	Minimum of 3&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in Total Rewards, Compensation &amp; Benefits, HR Operations, Payroll or a related HR function.
	Strong understanding of compensation structures, salary administration and employee benefits.
	Good knowledge of Nigerian payroll, PAYE, pension and other relevant statutory requirements.
	Demonstrable experience in salary benchmarking, job evaluation, grading and compensation analysis.
	Experience supporting incentive, bonus and employee recognition programmes.
	Strong numerical, analytical and data interpretation skills.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with HR/payroll systems.
	Excellent attention to detail and strong ability to work with confidential employee data.
	Strong communication and employee advisory skills.
	Ability to analyse complex data and convert findings into practical recommendations.
	Strong organisational skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines.


Key Competencies:


	Total Rewards Management
	Compensation &amp; Benefits
	Salary Benchmarking
	Job Evaluation &amp; Grading
	Compensation Analytics
	Reward Strategy
	Benefits Administration
	Incentive &amp; Bonus Management
	Employee Recognition
	Payroll Controls
	Reward Budgeting
	HR Data Analytics
	Market Intelligence
	Statutory Compliance
	Employee Advisory
	Advanced Excel
	Confidentiality &amp; Integrity
	Process Improvement


The Ideal Candidate:


	The ideal candidate will be analytical, commercially minded, numerate and highly detail-oriented, with the ability to understand both the financial and employee implications of reward decisions.
	You should be comfortable working with sensitive compensation data, analysing large volumes of information and providing clear recommendations to HR and Management.
	Beyond routine compensation administration, the successful candidate should have the ability to contribute to building a fair, competitive and sustainable Total Rewards framework that supports employee attraction, engagement, performance and retention.
